meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 DNAnexus 云平台上的基因组学数据：上传/下载文件、运行分析任务、构建应用和工作流，以及用 Python SDK 编写自动化脚本。
howto.when: 当你需要处理基因组数据（如 FASTQ、BAM、VCF 文件），或要在 DNAnexus 上创建应用、运行分析、管理项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我上传 sample.fastq 到项目 project-xxxx。
say.note: Claude 会使用 dxpy 上传文件。

say.text: 创建一个 applet，对 FASTQ 文件做质量过滤。
say.note: Claude 会生成 app 骨架和代码。

say.text: 列出项目里所有 BAM 文件并下载。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并下载文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage genomics data on the DNAnexus cloud platform: upload/download files, run analyses, build apps and workflows, and write automation scripts using the dxpy Python SDK.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to handle genomics data (e.g., FASTQ, BAM, VCF files), create apps, run analyses, or manage projects on DNAnexus.

say_en.note: Claude will use dxpy to upload the file.

say_en.text: Create an applet to quality-filter FASTQ files.
say_en.note: Claude will generate app skeleton and code.

say_en.text: List all BAM files in the project and download them.
say_en.note: Claude will search and download files.
